name: Haken Seifuku
source:
Main character owns a bar. One day he receives a letter urging him to avenge his dead parents and defeat Kagura group that controls the underground business of the city. But he does not have to fight alone - bar is full of girls suffered from the Kagura group. The power of their cosplay will infect the other shops of the city.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角經營著一家酒吧。某天，他收到一封信，信中催促他為死去的父母報仇，擊敗控制城市地下產業的神樂集團。但他並非孤軍奮戰——酒吧裡聚集著許多深受神樂集團迫害的女孩。她們的角色扮演之力將感染城中其他店家。

[譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
